scopeGuards.advancedCognition: Foundation provides contracts/hooks only; implementation research is out of Foundation scope.
scopeGuards.management: Canonical Management Contract first; CLI provides complete reference coverage.
scopeGuards.presentation: HTTP/API and semantic Presentation contracts may be Foundation; Web/GUI visual/runtime implementation is independent.
scopeGuards.dependencySelection: Use L0 direct evidence, then minimal L1/L2 probes only for unresolved properties; L3 product qualification follows implementation.
scopeGuards.dependencyRouting: ADOPTED roles must use references/dependency-routing.json through the designated adapter; conservative no-dependency/custom fallbacks are not permitted without reopening the role.
scopeGuards.dependencyMaterialization: Adopted npm routes are materialized in pnpm-workspace.yaml Catalogs with catalogMode=strict; Nx/ESLint/dependency-route gates restrict imports to approved adapter boundaries.
scopeGuards.toolchain: TypeScript 7 is the primary compiler with ESNext/NodeNext/ESM-first; TS6 is an isolated compiler-API compatibility lane only. Exact versions come from current registry/upstream evidence and are pinned in Catalog/lockfile; prerelease labels are evidence, not automatic rejection.
scopeGuards.preProductionCompatibility: CompatibilityEpoch=PRE_PRODUCTION: project-owned development formats have no backward-compatibility obligation; keep one current canonical V1 and reject/reset obsolete development shapes. A production compatibility obligation requires an explicit architecture transition.
